press_references.value: Octopart Discover for context-driven electronics design

product_launches.description: Octopart launched Octopart Discover, a new context-driven extension of its component search platform that helps electronics engineers start from system-level design intent and maintain live design context while exploring components.

overview_description.description:
Octopart was founded by a trio of experimental physicists with a vision of a better way to find parts online. Today, over 700,000 engineers, scientists and sourcing professionals use our tools to search for parts across thousands of suppliers. We manage structured data for 30 million parts and growing. Our mission is to open up access to part data in design, sourcing and manufacturing.

Like most startups, our existence depends on our innovations and hard work. Unlike many startups, Octopart has not raised any venture capital beyond Y-Combinator, and we stay in business by being profitable.

product.name: Octopart Electronic Component Search Platform
product.description: A search and comparison platform for electronic components, providing technical specifications, pricing, availability, datasheets, reference designs, CAD models, and alternative-part information.

product.name: Octopart BOM Tool
product.description: A browser-based bill of materials tool that matches listed components, compares distributor offers, optimizes sourcing, analyzes supply-chain data, and supports exports or linked purchasing carts.

product.name: Nexar API
product.description: An API providing electronic component data for design and sourcing applications, including part information and supply-chain details.

product.name: Octopart Partner Solutions
product.description: Business services for electronic component manufacturers and distributors to publish product data, improve listing visibility, reach active buyers, and access analytics on demand and engagement.

product.name: The Pulse
product.description: An electronics industry publication covering PCB design, electronic components, procurement, supply-chain strategies, and related technology topics.
